reason: The original existential target asks for two distinct global surreal derivations agreeing on the entire real/log-atomic exp-log-summation closure K. The PR proves agreement closure, leading-term rigidity, an equivalent globally summable perturbation/fixed-point criterion and surjectivity invariance, plus restricted path/contraction/automorphism obstructions. It neither constructs a nonzero datum satisfying W,F,L0,B for some derivation nor proves every such datum zero for every derivation. A formal single-path solution does not provide global summability, and uniqueness of one canonical recipe or rigidity of monomial-preserving conjugation is not global uniqueness. The corrected dominance lemma fixes a subsidiary hypothesis only. Treat the criterion as an exact remaining gap, not a solution.
